cards.card_text: The Moabites and the Ammonites The Edomites and the Midianites The Amalekites and the Philistines
cards.verse_text: He is the father of the Moabites of today.
cards.snippet: He is the father of the Moabites of today.

cards.card_text: The Israelites and Moses, Israel's leader, are still on the move through the wilderness, camping place after place until they cross the Arnon, the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.
cards.verse_text: Now the Arnon is the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.
cards.snippet: Now the Arnon is the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.

cards.card_text: When Balak hears Balaam is coming, he goes out to meet him at the Moabite city on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.
cards.verse_text: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite city on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.
cards.snippet: …that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite city on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.

cards.card_text: The Moabites are descendants of Lot, Abraham's nephew (Genesis 12:5; 19:36-37), and the LORD has a word for Moses about them.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
cards.snippet: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any…

cards.card_text: The LORD tells Moses that Israel should drive the Moabites out of their land.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
cards.snippet: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any…

cards.card_text: The Moabites called them Emites, but like the Anakites, they were regarded as Rephaim.
cards.verse_text: Like the Anakites, they were also regarded as Rephaim, though the Moabites called them Emites.
cards.snippet: Like the Anakites, they were also regarded as Rephaim, though the Moabites called them Emites.

cards.card_text: Moses tells Sihon that Esau's descendants in Seir and the Moabites in Ar already let Israel do the same thing.
cards.verse_text: just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us, until we cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us.”
cards.snippet: just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us, until we cross the Jordan…

cards.card_text: Then Moses names two whole nations: no Ammonite or Moabite may enter either, even to the tenth generation, and he tells Israel exactly why.
cards.verse_text: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, even to the tenth generation.
cards.snippet: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD,…

cards.card_text: True or false: he tells them the LORD has delivered the Moabites into their hand.
cards.verse_text: “Follow me,” he told them, “for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” So they followed him down and seized the fords of the Jordan leading to Moab, and they did not allow anyone to cross over.
cards.snippet: …me,” he told them, “for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” So they followed him down and seized the fords…

cards.card_text: At that time they strike down about ten thousand Moabites, all robust and valiant men.
cards.verse_text: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all robust and valiant men.
cards.snippet: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all robust and valiant men.

cards.card_text: Naomi's sons marry two Moabite women.
cards.verse_text: who took Moabite women as their wives, one named Orpah and the other named Ruth.
cards.snippet: who took Moabite women as their wives, one named Orpah and the other named Ruth.

cards.card_text: From the time Saul takes the kingship over Israel, he fights enemies on every side: the Moabites, the Ammonites, the Edomites, the kings of Zobah and the Philistines.
cards.verse_text: After Saul had assumed the kingship over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side—the Moabites, the Ammonites, the Edomites, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines.
cards.snippet: …kingship over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side—the Moabites, the Ammonites, the Edomites, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines.

cards.card_text: Next, David defeats the Moabites.
cards.verse_text: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with a cord.
cards.snippet: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with…

cards.card_text: Two lengths of David's cord marked the Moabites who would be put to death.
cards.verse_text: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with a cord.
cards.snippet: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with…

cards.card_text: Now the Moabites are subject to David.
cards.verse_text: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with a cord.
cards.snippet: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with…

cards.card_text: The LORD names the gods: Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites and Milcom the god of the Ammonites.
cards.verse_text: For they have forsaken Me to worship Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the Ammonites.
cards.snippet: …worship Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the Ammonites.

cards.card_text: Elisha says this is a ___ matter in the sight of the LORD, and He will also deliver the Moabites into their hand.
cards.verse_text: This is a simple matter in the sight of the LORD, and He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
cards.snippet: …in the sight of the LORD, and He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

cards.card_text: From across the way, what does that water look like to the Moabites?
cards.verse_text: When they got up early in the morning, the sun was shining on the water, and it looked as red as blood to the Moabites across the way.
cards.snippet: …on the water, and it looked as red as blood to the Moabites across the way.

cards.card_text: True or false: when the Moabites get to the camp of Israel, they find it empty.
cards.verse_text: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and attacked them, and they fled before them.
cards.snippet: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and attacked…

cards.card_text: The Israelites rise up and attack, and the Moabites flee before them, so Israel invades their land and strikes down the Moabites.
cards.verse_text: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and attacked them, and they fled before them.
cards.snippet: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and attacked…

cards.card_text: They were built for Ashtoreth, Chemosh and Milcom, the abominations of the Sidonians, the Moabites and the Ammonites.
cards.verse_text: The king also desecrated the high places east of Jerusalem, to the south of the Mount of Corruption, which King Solomon of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
cards.snippet: …Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

cards.card_text: Then raiders come against Jehoiakim to destroy Judah: Chaldeans, Arameans, Moabites and Ammonites.
cards.verse_text: And the LORD sent Chaldean, Aramean, Moabite, and Ammonite raiders against Jehoiakim in order to destroy Judah, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servants the prophets.
cards.snippet: And the LORD sent Chaldean, Aramean, Moabite, and Ammonite raiders against Jehoiakim in order to destroy Judah, according to…

cards.card_text: Chaldean, Aramean, Moabite and Ammonite raiders come against Jehoiakim.
cards.verse_text: And the LORD sent Chaldean, Aramean, Moabite, and Ammonite raiders against Jehoiakim in order to destroy Judah, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servants the prophets.
cards.snippet: And the LORD sent Chaldean, Aramean, Moabite, and Ammonite raiders against Jehoiakim in order to destroy Judah, according to…

cards.card_text: Then comes the long roll call of the mighty men, from Asahel the brother of Joab down to Jaasiel the Mezobaite, with names like Zelek the Ammonite, Ithmah the Moabite and Uriah the Hittite.
cards.verse_text: Now these were the mighty men: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem, Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite, Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites, Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hurai from the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur, Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite, Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai, Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri, Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah, Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite, Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai, Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him, Hanan son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite, Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite, Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite, Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite, Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
cards.snippet: …Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite, Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

cards.card_text: David also defeats the Moabites.
cards.verse_text: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to David and brought him tribute.
cards.snippet: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to David and brought him tribute.

cards.card_text: The Moabites and Ammonites, together with some of the Meunites, come to make war against him.
cards.verse_text: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites, together with some of the Meunites, came to make war against Jehoshaphat.
cards.snippet: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites, together with some of the Meunites, came to make war…

cards.card_text: Then the Ammonites and Moabites rise up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction.
cards.verse_text: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction.
cards.snippet: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction.

cards.card_text: Once Seir is finished off, the Ammonites and Moabites make peace with each other.
cards.verse_text: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction.
cards.snippet: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction.

cards.card_text: They say those peoples have abominations like those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians and more.
cards.verse_text: After these things had been accomplished, the leaders approached me and said, “The people of Israel, including the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the surrounding peoples whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.
cards.snippet: …whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.

cards.card_text: And in it, they find a passage about two neighboring peoples: the Ammonites and the Moabites.
cards.verse_text: At that time the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people, and in it they found the passage stating that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God,
cards.snippet: …and in it they found the passage stating that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God,

cards.card_text: The Book of Moses has a rule about the Ammonites and the Moabites.
cards.verse_text: At that time the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people, and in it they found the passage stating that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God,
cards.snippet: …and in it they found the passage stating that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God,
